formulas.new: count distinct artifactId with verified BAN_HANH_MOI in period
formulas.revised: count distinct artifactId/version with verified BAN_HANH_SUA_DOI or THAY_THE in period
formulas.uniqueIssued: count distinct artifactId with any verified release event in period
formulas.withdrawn: count distinct artifactId with verified THU_HOI or HET_HIEU_LUC in period
formulas.effectiveAtPeriodEnd: count distinct artifactId whose latest valid effective state at cutoff is active
formulas.pendingApproval: count accepted outputs with checked evidence but no verified release event
formulas.sourceSplit: group release events by workSource; do not count source tasks instead
formulas.masterAndVariant: only count new variant as independent artifact if it has independently approved code, version and source file
formulas.hours: sum distinct ledger rows by actor and stage, not from any report aggregation
